about: Fixed inputs for testing each step of the desk on its own (evals/spans.py). The lead's steps use the eval questions (golden.json); the analyst's tasks are separate, written to need different analyses; the brief step's findings are written here and their figures produced by code from the release file. Like golden.json, nothing here may appear in any agent's instructions.

pick.question: Why is unemployment so high among educated young people in India?
pick.note: live run 2026-11-14: 4 tasks at once, groups named 'graduate', three analysts stopped

analyst.task: How does women's unemployment compare with men's in rural and in urban areas in 2025?
Which social groups have the highest and lowest labour force participation?
Which states saw the biggest change in the worker population ratio since 2024?
How has unemployment among 15-29 year olds moved month by month?
Do states where more women are in work also have lower unemployment among women?
For men's labour force participation, which way of splitting the figures shows the biggest differences?

Find the unemployment rate (UR) for education levels 7.graduate and 8.post graduate & above and the overall UR for all ages, state All India, measure CWS, for years 2024 and 2025; give the gap between each education level and overall and whether the gap widened or narrowed.
Compare unemployment among Muslim women and Hindu women in 2025, against all women.

findings.task: How does unemployment of young women in cities compare with young men's, and in villages?
findings.claim: In 2025, unemployment of 15-29 year olds in cities was 18.9% for women and 11.8% for men, a gap of +7.1 points, against +0.4 in villages.

findings.task: How many young urban women are in the labour force, against young urban men?
findings.claim: Only 23.2% of urban women aged 15-29 were in the labour force in 2025, against 60.9% of urban men that age.

findings.task: Is unemployment higher in the latest month than a year earlier?
findings.claim: Unemployment was 5% in September 2026 against 5.2% in September 2025 (-0.2 points).

findings.task: How has unemployment moved month by month?
findings.claim: Monthly unemployment stayed between 4.7% and 5.6% from April 2025 to September 2026.

findings.task: Which states have the lowest participation of women in the labour force?
findings.claim: Delhi has the lowest participation of women, 13.1% in 2025, against 40% for women in all of India.

findings.task: What is the unemployment rate of Muslim women in Kerala?
findings.claim: There is no figure for Muslim women in Kerala: religion is published only for all of India. Muslim women in all of India: 3.6%; all women in Kerala: 6.4% (2025).

findings.task: Do states with higher labour force participation also have more people in work?
findings.claim: Across 36 states, labour force participation and the worker population ratio go together closely (r = 0.99) in 2025.

findings.task: Are women in Nagaland more likely than men to be unemployed?
findings.claim: In Nagaland in 2025, women's unemployment was 8.4% against men's 5.3%, a gap of +3.1 points.

findings.task: Which state has the highest unemployment among women?
findings.claim: Andaman & Nicobar Islands has the highest unemployment among women, 16.4% in 2025, followed by Chandigarh at 14.2%.

findings.task: How does unemployment differ by education?
findings.claim: Graduates have the highest unemployment, 11.2% in 2025, against 3.1% for everyone and 0.3% for those not literate.
